summary: The step-up challenge start now spends the shared challenge issuance budget and returns 429 when challenge storage is full; regression tests cover identity, source, global, and capacity limits.

evidence: src/passport.ts:1132-1134 now calls allowChallengeIssuance for step-up starts and returns 429 rate_limited when the source, identity, or global challenge budget is exhausted.
src/passport.ts:1144-1152 checks the saveChallenge result and returns 429 rate_limited instead of a 200 for an unstored challenge when the 1024-record capacity is full.
tests/bun_test.ts:1560-1601 verify step-up starts share identity, source, and global issuance budgets with login and registration starts.
tests/bun_test.ts:1603-1629 verify full challenge storage rejects with 429 and a successful step-up challenge is persisted with its binding fields.
